plugin_cs2_description: This CS2 match's score, rounds, your stats and the bomb countdown, from Valve's official Game State Integration (one file in the game's cfg folder)
plugin_cs2_push_bomb_when: The bomb is planted this round
plugin_cs2_push_bomb_what: A card counting down from 40 seconds (the game's bomb timer; the game's own countdown when spectating), updated in place when it is defused, explodes or the round ends
plugin_cs2_push_bomb_ten_when: 10 seconds before the planted bomb explodes, if it was not defused
plugin_cs2_push_bomb_ten_what: She says “ten seconds left on the bomb” and a line is shown
plugin_cs2_push_match_point_when: In Competitive, Premier and Wingman, one side is one round away from winning the map (by the mode's round count; Competitive and Premier overtime included)
plugin_cs2_push_match_point_what: She says “we're on match point” or “they're on match point” and a line with the score is shown
plugin_cs2_push_halftime_when: Sides switch at halftime (overtime halves too)
plugin_cs2_push_halftime_what: She says “halftime, 7 to 5” and a line with the score is shown
plugin_cs2_push_match_end_what: A card: map, mode, score, won or lost, your kills / deaths / assists and MVPs, who won each round; a short note for her
plugin_cs2_off_note: Turn it on and Kotone receives the data CS2 itself sends on this computer (Valve's official Game State Integration). This page shows the match's score, rounds and your stats, and you get pushes for the bomb, match point, halftime and the end of the match.
plugin_cs2_idle: Open CS2 and join a match: the score, rounds and your stats show up here.
plugin_cs2_menu: CS2 is open, in the main menu.
plugin_cs2_bomb_empty: Open a bomb countdown push in the chat to see it here.
plugin_cs2_cfg_desc: CS2 only sends data to addresses registered in its cfg folder. Kotone puts gamestate_integration_kotone.cfg there: data goes only to port {port} on this computer, with a random token. Turning it off deletes that file (only the one Kotone wrote); while CS2 is open, writing and deleting wait until it closes.
plugin_cs2_cfg_wait_write: Will be written when CS2 closes
plugin_cs2_cfg_wait_remove: Will be deleted when CS2 closes
plugin_cs2_cfg_foreign: A file with the same name was not written by Kotone; left alone
plugin_cs2_cfg_not_installed: CS2 was not found in Steam on this computer.
plugin_cs2_cfg_isolated: This is an isolated test instance; it does not look for CS2 on this computer.
plugin_cs2_cfg_restart: The config file was written after CS2 started: restart CS2 to receive data.
plugin_cs2_listen_failed: The port for receiving data could not be opened: {error}
